lede: South Carolina carries the stronger underlying team rating — +4.2 against +2.7, a 1.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Alabama -11.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Alabama winning 78% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offensive line, where South Carolina leads Alabama by 35 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 76% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
